items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: They had Kenny Kersey on piano and Jimmy on drums

ctx.x: I don't know about the son. He was a bass player, a good one, Hodgkins. They had Kenny Kersey on piano and Jimmy on drums, Edmund Hall on clarinet.
And that was it, you were ready. And did that band stay together a long time like that or did other people come in and out of the band? Did that band remain the same?
